illustrations.name: Solar System and camera journey
illustrations.notes: Schematic planetary orbits, compressed positions and sizes, and an imagined camera path. Not a physical simulation or a measured route through the Webb field. Earth uses NASA photography; the Milky Way uses separately credited NASA/ESO artwork.

illustrations.name: Volumetric spiral galaxy
illustrations.type: procedural 3D particle illustration projected to Canvas 2D
illustrations.notes: Four spiral arms, warm central bulge, stars and diffuse dust distributed in three dimensions with perspective and near clipping. Illustrative geometry, not a measured Milky Way model. The credited NASA/ESO image remains only in static scenes.

illustrations.name: Rotating planets and orbital motion
illustrations.type: procedural spherical surface and schematic orbit animation
illustrations.notes: All eight planets orbit and spin using individual accelerated cinematic periods. Non-Earth surface details are illustrative procedural textures; Earth uses the separately credited NASA global mosaic. The moving Earth position is shared with the camera to preserve the nested approach. Not real-time ephemerides or measured rotation rates.
